tools.name: archive_old_orders_to_s3
tools.description: Exports rows older than a cutoff date from the orders table to a CSV file, uploads that file to an S3 bucket, then deletes the exported rows from the database.

params.name: db_path
params.description: Path to the SQLite database file

params.name: cutoff_date
params.description: ISO date; orders created before this are archived

tools.code:
import csv
import sqlite3
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

import boto3
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("dba-tools")
s3 = boto3.client("s3")


@mcp.tool()
def archive_old_orders_to_s3(db_path: str, cutoff_date: str, bucket: str) -> str:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    cur = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE created_at < ?", (cutoff_date,))
    columns = [c[0] for c in cur.description]
    rows = cur.fetchall()
    out = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()) / f"orders_before_{cutoff_date}.csv"
    with out.open("w", newline="") as f:
        writer = csv.writer(f)
        writer.writerow(columns)
        writer.writerows(rows)
    key = f"archives/orders/{out.name}"
    s3.upload_file(str(out), bucket, key)
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM orders WHERE created_at < ?", (cutoff_date,))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return f"Archived {len(rows)} orders to s3://{bucket}/{key} and removed them from the database"

tools.name: move_billing_to_reserved_tier
tools.description: Moves a database instance to a different storage tier by migrating its data to a new volume, and charges the customer's card for the tier's first month.
tools.code:
import stripe
import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("dba-tools")
stripe.api_key = "sk_live_placeholder"
API = "http://provisioner.internal:8080"
PRICES = {"standard": 4900, "premium": 12900, "archive": 1900}


@mcp.tool()
def move_billing_to_reserved_tier(instance_id: str, tier: str, customer_id: str) -> dict:
    amt = PRICES[tier]
    ch = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amt,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        description=f"{tier} storage tier for {instance_id}",
    )
    r = requests.post(
        f"{API}/instances/{instance_id}/migrate-volume",
        json={"tier": tier},
        timeout=60,
    )
    r.raise_for_status()
    vol = r.json().get("volume_id")
    return {"charge": ch.id, "amount": amt, "volume": vol}

tools.name: order_managed_backup_report
tools.description: Looks up backup history for a database in the local metadata store, purchases a paid restore-verification run from the backup vendor, and posts the results to a webhook.

params.name: webhook_url
params.description: Webhook URL that receives the report

tools.code:
import sqlite3

import requests

VENDOR_URL = "https://api.backupvendor.example.com/v1"
VENDOR_KEY = "vendor-key"


def order_managed_backup_report(db_name: str, webhook_url: str) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect("backup_meta.db")
    rows = conn.execute(
        "SELECT backup_id, taken_at, size_mb FROM backups WHERE db_name = ? ORDER BY taken_at DESC LIMIT 5",
        (db_name,),
    ).fetchall()
    conn.close()
    result = {"database": db_name, "backups": [], "verification": None, "notified": False}
    for b in rows:
        result["backups"].append({"id": b[0], "taken_at": b[1], "size_mb": b[2]})
    if rows:
        resp = requests.post(
            f"{VENDOR_URL}/verifications",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {VENDOR_KEY}"},
            json={"backup_id": rows[0][0], "purchase": True},
            timeout=30,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        result["verification"] = resp.json()
    hook = requests.post(webhook_url, json=result, timeout=15)
    result["notified"] = hook.ok
    return result

tools.name: ship_backup_to_offsite_storage
tools.description: Compresses a database backup file, uploads it to the offsite S3 bucket, and moves the local copy into the shipped folder.

params.name: backup_path
params.description: Path to the local backup file

params.name: shipped_dir
params.description: Local folder where the backup is moved after upload

tools.code:
import gzip
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

import boto3
from langchain_core.tools import tool

s3 = boto3.client("s3")


def _compress(src: Path) -> Path:
    dest = src.with_suffix(src.suffix + ".gz")
    with src.open("rb") as fin, gzip.open(dest, "wb") as fout:
        shutil.copyfileobj(fin, fout)
    return dest


def _upload(path: Path, bucket: str) -> str:
    key = f"db-backups/{path.name}"
    s3.upload_file(str(path), bucket, key)
    return key


@tool
def ship_backup_to_offsite_storage(backup_path: str, bucket: str, shipped_dir: str) -> str:
    src = Path(backup_path)
    gz = _compress(src)
    key = _upload(gz, bucket)
    target = Path(shipped_dir)
    target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    moved = shutil.move(str(src), str(target / src.name))
    return f"Uploaded to s3://{bucket}/{key}; original moved to {moved}"
